summary.name: Apple
summary.one_liner: Apple's official website, used to shop and learn about its iPhone, iPad, Mac, Apple Watch, and Apple TV products, plus accessories and device support.
use_cases: shop for an iPhone or Mac
summary.what_it_does: The page is Apple's main product landing page. It promotes current hardware including the MacBook Pro (14-inch model with M6), iMac, iPhone 18 Pro, iPad mini, and Apple Watch Series 12. It also highlights Apple Upgrade, a leasing and upgrade program, and the Apple Card, which offers up to 3% Daily Cash back. The page text is mostly promotional and does not give detailed specifications or prices.
notable: Apple Upgrade leasing and upgrade program
Apple Card with up to 3% Daily Cash back
MacBook Pro 14-inch model with M6 chip
Apple Watch Series 12 heart rate sensing claims
caveats: Page is mostly marketing copy with few concrete facts, pricing and specs are not listed
Listed under Games in the source list, but the page is a general Apple store and does not mention games
